name: overte-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Overte domain-server administration (real), with in-world entity spawning and JavaScript hot-reload scripting currently simulated pending a WebSocket bridge. Targets Overte, not current Vircadia (unrelated pivoted stack) -- see README.
author: sandraschi

tools.name: overte_domain_status
tools.description: Retrieve connected-node telemetry and settings from an Overte Domain Server via /nodes.json and /settings.json. Real, unverified against a live server; falls back to labeled simulated data if unreachable.

username.description: HTTP Basic Auth username for the domain-server admin API

password.description: HTTP Basic Auth password for the domain-server admin API

tools.name: overte_entity_spawn
tools.description: Spawn an entity (Box, Sphere, Web, Model) in the Overte world. Verified live via WebSocket bridge (2026-07-30). Falls back to simulated when bridge disconnected.

type.description: Entity type: Box, Sphere, Web, Model

model_url.description: GLB/FBX model resource URL if type is Model

script_url.description: Optional JavaScript behavior script URL to attach

tools.name: overte_script_inject
tools.description: Inject JavaScript behavior onto an Overte entity. Live when WebSocket bridge is connected; simulated fallback when disconnected. Every response indicates its data source.

script_data.description: Metadata parameters to inject into the script scope
